admission_process_steps.title: Apply Online
admission_process_steps.description: Fill the online application form on the official admission portal (admission.sharda.ac.in) and pay the nominal application fee of Rs. 1500.

admission_process_steps.title: Appear for SUAT / National Exam
admission_process_steps.description: Book a convenient slot and appear for the Sharda University Admission Test (SUAT) or submit valid national exam scores (JEE Main, NEET, CAT, MAT, CLAT, NATA, CUET).

admission_process_steps.title: Personal Interview / GD (If Applicable)
admission_process_steps.description: Attend the Personal Interview (PI) or Group Discussion (GD) for specialized courses like MBA, Medical, Dental, or Design Portfolio Review.

admission_process_steps.title: Offer Letter & Fee Payment
admission_process_steps.description: Qualified candidates receive a provisional admission offer letter. Pay the admission confirmation fee to secure your seat.

admission_process_steps.title: Document Verification & Orientation
admission_process_steps.description: Submit original academic certificates and ID proofs at the Admissions Office during document verification day and attend the fresher orientation.
